scope: Conditional exact one-sided Fisher 2x2 odds-ratio power for one physical site/date-pair with known equal exposure in four season×two-solar-phase cells, synthetic observations only
table_definition: Rows rising/falling each have n events; columns early/late each have n events; X=falling-early and other counts are rising-early=n-X, falling-late=n-X, rising-late=X.
scientific_estimand: Detector-weighted occurrence rate odds ratio (falling/rising rate in early bin)/(falling/rising rate in late bin); not automatically latent animal activity
sampling_law: Conditional on these exact row/column totals, X follows Fisher's noncentral hypergeometric P_theta(X=x) proportional to choose(n,x)^2 * theta^x for 0<=x<=n.

test.pvalue_definition: Central hypergeometric exact upper tail P_theta=1(X>=observed)
test.critical_value_rule: smallest integer c with P_theta=1(X>=c)<=alpha; none means cannot reject
test.calibration: exact conditional size <=0.05, discreteness means not equal to 0.05

admission_gates: exact conditional size under null <=0.05 for every n from 5 to 640
theta=1 power equals exact conditional type I error for every n
true positive OR 1.5,2,3 has nondecreasing power in effect size for fixed n
predeclared exact n grid and first/sustained 80-percent thresholds without effect-size tuning
no scientific inference from published whole-year 4623 ungulate detections to same-site paired-day two-bin n
never interpret a 2-bin exact contrast as detection of six-bin profile change without separate multiplicity control
no original animal events, camera device uptime or precise station coordinates accessed
